decisive_items: firm to hard without changes in the overlying skin
plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
response.rationale: R5 is the champion because its clinical and cytological features are most consistent with dermatofibroma, a type of benign skin tumor. R2 is the runner-up because it also has some consistent features with fibromatosis, but the firmness of the lesions and the presence of plump spindle cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm are more typical of dermatofibroma.

rejected.why: lack of necrosis and inflammatory cells is not typical of dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
firmness of the lesions is not typical of lipomatosis
presence of multiple subcutaneous masses is not exclusive to neurofibroma
